name: Form
summary: Native form composition with container-responsive rows, canonical Field Wrapper and Button children, optional actions and linked error summary, and target-owned submission policy.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native form root and form-associated control boundary on Web.

anatomy.name: section
anatomy.description: Optional major group within the form.

anatomy.name: twoColumnRow
anatomy.description: Two-column row compatibility modifier activated by container capacity.

anatomy.name: threeColumnRow
anatomy.description: Three-column row compatibility modifier activated by container capacity.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Submit, cancel, or secondary action row.

anatomy.name: errorSummary
anatomy.description: Top-level summary of form validation errors.

anatomy.name: errorSummaryList
anatomy.description: List of links or messages for invalid fields.

anatomy.name: errorSummaryLink
anatomy.description: Optional link from the error summary to a specific invalid field.

states.name: twoColumn
states.description: Two-column intent is present and activates only with sufficient form-container capacity.

states.name: threeColumn
states.description: Three-column intent is present and activates only with sufficient form-container capacity.

states.name: errorSummaryFocus
states.description: Programmatically focusable summary has a visible focus treatment when the target moves focus after failed submission.

behavior.name: nativeSubmission
behavior.description: Web uses a real form so named controls, activated submitter, validation, entry-list construction, submit, and reset remain native unless the target explicitly owns persistence.

behavior.name: fieldComposition
behavior.description: Forms compose Field Wrapper and input controls while preserving a logical reading and tab order.

behavior.name: responsiveRows
behavior.description: Container-responsive row modifiers change only grid columns and never source, reading, or keyboard order.

behavior.name: actionSemantics
behavior.description: Canonical Button children use explicit action types; pending or disabled submission policy remains target-owned.

behavior.name: errorSummary
attributes: optional role and aria-live chosen by target timing
behavior.description: A text summary links to invalid fields. The target owns insertion, announcement, and whether focus moves to the summary or first invalid control.

behavior.name: valueOwnership
events: input and change on composed controls
behavior.description: Form does not mirror a controlled value object; each canonical control remains the owner of its own native current and default value.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Responsive field count for a composed form row.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Canonical named controls and optional sections/rows in logical source order.

properties.name: errorSummary
properties.description: Optional top-level summary that links validation errors to their fields.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional explicit submit and secondary action row.

properties.name: noValidate
properties.description: Disables native browser validation when the target owns a complete accessible validation flow.

accessibility: Use a native form element for the neutral Web implementation.
Give submitted controls stable names and preserve the activated submitter in native form data.
Keep field order, visual order, and tab order aligned.
Use explicit button types for submit, reset, and non-submit actions.
Provide a top-level error summary for longer forms with multiple invalid fields.
Link error summary items to their invalid fields when the target supports focusable anchors.
Let the target validation lifecycle choose error-summary insertion, live announcement, and focus timing.
Preserve native default values and reset behavior for every composed control.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/forms.css; validation, submission, pending state, and error-summary focus behavior are target responsibilities.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render native forms, field wrappers, buttons, and error summaries with this class contract.
